column1: # The documented overrides of hc-humanize's CLDR 48 data.
# scripts/humanize-cldr.py resolves every value of the 32 locales from its
# CLDR 48 file and then replaces the values listed here, writing each
# reason above the value in src/data/cldr48.rs; docs/i18n.md lists them.
# tests/cldr48_resolved.rs holds that every value differs from CLDR's own
# resolution only where this list says so, that every value here differs
# from CLDR's, and that it is the one the crate carries.
# One override a line, four cells separated by tabs: the tag, the key, the
# value (`-` for none) and the reason. A key is STYLE.UNIT.KIND.CATEGORY
# (KIND past, future or count; CATEGORY a plural category),
# unit or narrow; PART 2, start, middle or end), decimal or at (the
# relative date-time pattern, in this crate's order).
# Every reason is (c): a value of CLDR's that a source argues against, with
# the value kept. A source is cited by its key in docs/references.bib and
